data.long_meaning: Elizabeth means 'God's oath of abundance.' The name is derived from the Hebrew words 'El' (God) and 'Bethes' (oath). In the New Testament, Elizabeth is the name of John the Baptist's mother. This name carries a rich history and symbolism, evoking images of faith, fertility, and divine promise.
